title: Cancel action
purpose: Cancel an open action on a nonconformance that is no longer needed, with a reason.
summary: Cancel an open action that is no longer needed, with a reason. The record's owner or a supervisor can do this.

tasks.title: Cancel an action
steps: Open the action's [[Actions]] menu on the record and select [[Cancel action]].
Explain why in [[Reason]] and select [[Cancel action]].

tasks.title: Replace it with a different action
steps: Cancel the old one, then select [[Add action]] on the record.

good_to_know: Cancelling cannot be undone. The action stays listed as Cancelled with your reason.
A cancelled action no longer stops the record from closing or from being checked Effective.
The person the action is assigned to cannot cancel it unless they own the record or are a supervisor.
To change the person or due date instead, use Edit action.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Opens from Cancel action in an action's menu on the record, as a dialog or a full page. Only the owner or a supervisor (the admin role included) may open it; anyone else is refused. While the optional nonconformance module is off it answers Not found.

items.label: Action, Person, Due
items.description: The action you are cancelling: its text, who does it and its due date.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required, up to 2,000 characters. Shown under Finished in the record's Actions table and kept in the history.

items.label: Cancel action
items.description: Sets the action to Cancelled, records you and the time, and confirms Action cancelled. The history records Action cancelled.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the record and leaves the action open.

items.label: Refusals
items.description: An action already done or cancelled: This action is already finished. A closed record: A closed nonconformance does not change. A supervisor can reopen it.

items.label: Stale form
items.description: This nonconformance changed after you opened it. Reload it and review the latest details. Your input is kept on the form.
